offers_products.reason: Sells SIMs/eSIMs, IoT hardware and the ConnectivityPro management platform, though connectivity service is the core.

offers_services.reason: Main offering is enterprise IoT connectivity service plus managed services, device testing and deployment support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are businesses deploying IoT devices, such as retailers, fleet operators, healthcare device makers and utilities.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Enterprise IoT connectivity sold to businesses like retailers, industrial equipment makers, fleet and EV charging operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing per-SIM connectivity subscriptions for devices deployed for years generate most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Connectivity keeps deployed devices running, so customers rarely cut it; new deployments may slow somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent per-SIM connectivity charges billed regularly, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from connectivity network, mobile core and software platform, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers range from large enterprises to small IoT firms; website text does not show which dominates.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs on carrier networks as an MVNO-style provider; owns a cloud-native core but not physical networks.
